title: Client component ownership across routes
prompt: Read-only reasoning exercise. Do not change files, access real user data or claim execution. A server-rendered page imports DOM-dependent Tabler behavior at server module evaluation. Tooltips initialize after an asynchronous import; the route can unmount before it finishes, and later remount. A proposal initializes every time without retaining instances. Review it.

checks.reason: Advisory signal only; the rubric judges decisions rather than keyword presence.

rubric: Keep browser-dependent initialization out of server evaluation and render functions.
Retain owner-scoped instances; avoid duplicates and dispose instances/listeners on unmount.
Invalidate stale asynchronous completion so unmounted owners cannot initialize later.
Require SSR and mount/unmount/remount observations rather than claiming execution.
acceptance: The response makes the specified contextual decisions, proposes discriminating observations and states evidence limits without inventing execution.
